answer_1.quote: This work presents a novel method that leverages prosodic features (pitch, energy and duration) to modify emotions in the output of a TTS system.
answer_1.outputs: synthesized speech with controlled emotional prosody

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the perceptual-quality/naturalness we compare Mean Opinion Score (MOS) averaged across forty subjects proficient in English. ... Annotator rates each sample on a Likert scale of one for 'completely unnatural' to five for 'completely natural'.
answer_4.guideline: Raters evaluated samples for naturalness on a 1-5 scale, identified perceived emotions from four categories (Happy, Sad, Angry, Fear), picked samples with higher emotion intensity, ranked settings for emotional consistency, and rated arousal/valence in live conversations.
